note: Hand-written. The same shape as none-statement-to-review, except this one names a specific thing to change: the escrow amount moved and the automatic transfer has to be updated to match. A statement is not automatically noise — it depends whether there is a lever.
subject: Your annual escrow analysis is ready

messages.subject: Your annual escrow analysis is ready
messages.body:
Hello,

Your annual escrow analysis for the loan ending 4192 is now available in online banking.

What changed

Your property taxes and hazard insurance premium both increased this year. As a result your monthly escrow payment is changing.

  Previous total monthly payment ......... $3,412.18
  New total monthly payment .............. $3,589.44
  Effective with the payment due .......... 1 October 2026

Action needed

If you pay your mortgage by automatic transfer from another institution, that transfer will not update on its own. You must change the transfer amount to $3,589.44 before your 1 October 2026 payment, or the payment will post short and a late fee may apply.

If you pay through Wexford online banking, no action is needed - we will adjust the amount for you.

View the full analysis at https://banking.wexford.example/escrow.
